correctness.rationale: Five cyclic false-twin classes yield exact necessary-and-sufficient domination and one-guard-swap security predicates. For cardinality <=5 and part sizes >=5, a fully occupied large class cannot be part of a dominating set; hence a fixed cap-six model is exact. The included integer-only enumerator visits every one of the 196 profiles of size <=5, finding precisely six secure size-five occupancy patterns and no smaller secure patterns. Multiplying independent binomial labelled choices derives the polynomial; the separate explicit-graph verifier corroborates five instances.
